panels.description: InfiniBand / RoCE throughput of each node running this cluster's GPU pods, summed over the node's RDMA ports. Each point is the average rate between the two latest samples (typically 60 s apart), so short bursts aren't visible.
panels.title: Node RDMA Network Throughput

panels.description: RDMA throughput across the nodes running this cluster's GPU pods. For each direction, the band spans the lowest to the highest node and the line is the median node. Each point is the average rate between the two latest samples (typically 60 s apart), so short bursts aren't visible. The per-node view is Node RDMA Network Throughput.
panels.title: Node RDMA Network Throughput (min / median / max)

panels.description: Times an RDMA network interface (rdma*, ib*) of a node running this cluster's GPU pods lost its link, per interval. All RDMA interfaces is the total: 0 when no link dropped, and absent where the cluster's Prometheus does not collect the counter.
panels.title: RDMA Link Drops

panels.description: Errors counted by the RDMA NICs of the nodes running this cluster's GPU pods, per interval: failed RDMA operations (completion errors), ack timeouts, remote invalid requests, and RoCE retransmits (recovery from packet loss; occasional ones are normal). All RDMA errors is the total without retransmits: 0 when there were none, and absent where the cluster's Prometheus does not collect the counters.

targets.expr:
(sum by (cluster, node) (clamp_min(
  (node_infiniband_req_cqes_errors_total{node=~"$node"} - node_infiniband_req_cqes_errors_total{node=~"$node"} offset $__interval)
  or
  (node_infiniband_req_cqes_errors_total{node=~"$node"} - min_over_time(node_infiniband_req_cqes_errors_total{node=~"$node"}[$__interval])),
  0
))
+
sum by (cluster, node) (clamp_min(
  (node_infiniband_resp_cqes_errors_total{node=~"$node"} - node_infiniband_resp_cqes_errors_total{node=~"$node"} offset $__interval)
  or
  (node_infiniband_resp_cqes_errors_total{node=~"$node"} - min_over_time(node_infiniband_resp_cqes_errors_total{node=~"$node"}[$__interval])),
  0
)))
* on(cluster, node) group_left()
group by (cluster, node) (
  DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{node=~"$node"}
  * on(pod, namespace) group_left(label_skypilot_cluster_name)
  group by (pod, namespace, label_skypilot_cluster_name) (
    kube_pod_labels{label_skypilot_cluster_name=~"$cluster"}
  )
)
> 0
